description: Java interface for supporting real-time streaming reads in Apache Spark, including nested class for record status and methods for offset management and record retrieval with timeout.

classes.name: SupportsRealTimeRead
classes.description: Interface extending PartitionReader for low latency streaming processing with methods to get offsets and fetch next record with timeout.

classes.name: RecordStatus
classes.description: Nested class representing the status of a record, including availability and optional arrival time.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset of the next record or start offset if none read.

methods.name: nextWithTimeout
methods.description: Proceeds to the next record, waiting up to the specified timeout if no record is immediately available.
